schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to travel at night or get to night shifts?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في التنقل ليلًا أو الوصول إلى ورديات العمل الليلية؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, nachts unterwegs zu sein oder zur Nachtschicht zu kommen?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to travel at night or get to night shifts?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که شب سفر کنید یا به شیفت شب برسید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de vous déplacer la nuit ou vous rendre à un travail de nuit ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy éjszaka utazni vagy éjszakai műszakba eljutni?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a spostarti di notte o raggiungere i turni di notte?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, geceleri yolculuk etmekten veya gece vardiyalarına gitmekten vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
